name: MD-03
label: Safe D

key_factors: Incumbent Sarah Elfreth running with a large fundraising edge
Prediction markets price a Democratic win around 95%
model.rationale: The fundamentals point strongly to the incumbent: a 12-point Democratic lean, a favorable environment, and a massive money advantage of over $1.1 million raised versus roughly $12,700 for Berney Flowers. Markets price this near-certain for Democrats, and no evidence suggests a competitive race.
model.watch: Any late polling showing Flowers gaining traction or unexpected outside spending could narrow the margin, though nothing currently signals competitiveness.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview:
First-term incumbent Sarah Elfreth defends a Maryland district that leans Democratic by about 12 points, in a year when the national environment also favors her party. She has raised more than $1.1 million and holds over $335,000 on hand, giving her a dominant resource position.

Republican Berney Flowers has raised only about $12,700 with minimal cash remaining, and no outside groups have invested in the race. Prediction markets price a Democratic win at roughly 95 percent, and no expert raters flag the seat as competitive. All available evidence points to a comfortable incumbent victory.
